change.title: Change the password
change.description: The database applies it first, then the panel saves it. If the database refuses, nothing changes.
change.rootHint: Leave empty to keep the root password as it is.
change.invalid: Use up to 256 characters, with no line breaks or other control characters.
change.passwordHint: The database applies it first, then the panel saves it.

rotation.title: A password change was interrupted
rotation.description: The panel can't tell whether it finished. Check again once the database is running.
rotation.failed: The password could not be confirmed

connection.heading: Connection
connection.signInHint: Whether the database accepts the password the panel holds, asked just now.

versions.heading: Version
versions.proposedHint: What new databases of this engine get today. It is only ever a suggestion: a newer default never touches this database or its data.
